dedupe_keys.name: model for a single storey flexible double skin fa ade system in ida ice

description: Elena Catto Lucchino and colleagues publish a numerical model of a flexible double-skin façade based on the IDA ICE Double Glass Facade component. It switches cavity ventilation strategies to represent adaptive operation and interaction with building environmental systems. The native description reports comparison with measurements from an outdoor TWINS test cell in Torino and performance comparable to the conventional component. Zenodo supplies the flexible-model ZIP freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the documented single-storey module; temporal sampling, detailed parameter schema and software-version requirements are not given. The related existing TWINS dataset represents experimental validation measurements and is not added again. A limitation is that the source’s accuracy claim was not independently checked. The model archive, code and measured values were not downloaded; implementation and compatibility remain untested.
